verses.pali: Saṁyutta Nikāya 36.10
1. Sagāthāvagga
Phassamūlakasutta
“Tisso imā, bhikkhave, vedanā phassajā phassamūlakā phassanidānā phassapaccayā.
verses.english: “Mendicants, these three feelings are born, rooted, sourced, and dependent on contact.

verses.pali: Katamā tisso?
Sukhā vedanā, dukkhā vedanā, adukkhamasukhā vedanā.
Sukhavedaniyaṁ, bhikkhave, phassaṁ paṭicca uppajjati sukhā vedanā.
verses.english: Pleasant feeling arises dependent on a contact to be experienced as pleasant.

verses.pali: Tasseva sukhavedaniyassa phassassa nirodhā, yaṁ tajjaṁ vedayitaṁ sukhavedaniyaṁ phassaṁ paṭicca uppannā sukhā vedanā, sā nirujjhati, sā vūpasammati.
verses.english: With the cessation of that contact to be experienced as pleasant, the corresponding pleasant feeling ceases and stops.

verses.pali: Dukkhavedaniyaṁ, bhikkhave, phassaṁ paṭicca uppajjati dukkhā vedanā.
verses.english: Painful feeling arises dependent on a contact to be experienced as painful.

verses.pali: Tasseva dukkhavedaniyassa phassassa nirodhā, yaṁ tajjaṁ vedayitaṁ dukkhavedaniyaṁ phassaṁ paṭicca uppannā dukkhā vedanā, sā nirujjhati, sā vūpasammati.
verses.english: With the cessation of that contact to be experienced as painful, the corresponding painful feeling ceases and stops.

verses.pali: Adukkhamasukhavedaniyaṁ, bhikkhave, phassaṁ paṭicca uppajjati adukkhamasukhā vedanā.
verses.english: Neutral feeling arises dependent on a contact to be experienced as neutral.

verses.pali: Tasseva adukkhamasukhavedaniyassa phassassa nirodhā, yaṁ tajjaṁ vedayitaṁ adukkhamasukhavedaniyaṁ phassaṁ paṭicca uppannā adukkhamasukhā vedanā, sā nirujjhati, sā vūpasammati.
verses.english: With the cessation of that contact to be experienced as neutral, the corresponding neutral feeling ceases and stops.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, dvinnaṁ kaṭṭhānaṁ saṅghaṭṭanasamodhānā usmā jāyati, tejo abhinibbattati. Tesaṁyeva kaṭṭhānaṁ nānābhāvā vinikkhepā, yā tajjā usmā, sā nirujjhati, sā vūpasammati.
verses.english: When you rub two sticks together, heat is generated and fire is produced. But when you part the sticks and lay them aside, any corresponding heat ceases and stops.

verses.pali: Evameva kho, bhikkhave, imā tisso vedanā phassajā phassamūlakā phassanidānā phassapaccayā.
verses.english: In the same way, these three feelings are born, rooted, sourced, and dependent on contact.

verses.pali: Tajjaṁ phassaṁ paṭicca tajjā vedanā uppajjanti.
verses.english: The appropriate feeling arises dependent on the corresponding contact.

verses.pali: Tajjassa phassassa nirodhā tajjā vedanā nirujjhantī”ti.
verses.english: When the corresponding contact ceases, the appropriate feeling ceases.”

verses.pali: Dasamaṁ.
Vedanāsaṁyuttassa sagāthāvaggo paṭhamo.
Tassuddānaṁ
Samādhi sukhaṁ pahānena,
pātālaṁ daṭṭhabbena ca;
Sallena ceva gelaññā,
anicca phassamūlakāti.
